title: Leonhard Center supports Next-Gen Education with a $9,925 grant
body: Suman Saha and Mahfuza Farooque received a $9,925 grant from the Leonhard Center at Penn State for “Next-Gen Education: Leveraging AI for Microlearning.” Saha served as principal investigator and Farooque as co-principal investigator. The award supported the project from July 2024 through May 2025.
